title: flex-end rows overflow left, over the docked nav
answers: Buttons/toolbar overlap the left nav at narrow widths
Header bar sits on top of the sidebar instead of behind it
Why does a flex row cross over the docked navigation at small viewport widths
Toolbar buttons disappear off the left edge over the nav
body:
Symptom: a top toolbar/controls row's buttons slide left and visually sit on top of (or spill behind) the docked left nav when the viewport/available width gets narrow.
Root cause: a flex row with `justify-content: flex-end` overflows toward its start edge (left, in LTR) once content no longer fits; combined with a high `z-index` (e.g. `theme.zIndex.sidemenu` = 1020 vs nav's z-index of 2), the overflowing content paints above the nav instead of being clipped behind it.
Fix pattern: use `justify-content: 'safe flex-end'` (not plain `flex-end`) so the row overflows to the right/end instead of the start, and add `flexWrap: 'wrap'` so button groups wrap to a new line rather than overflowing; relies on an ancestor (e.g. `main`) having `overflow: auto` on the side that should clip.
Constraints: applies to any flex-end-justified row that can run out of horizontal room next to a docked nav/sidebar; does not fix cases where a single child/group is itself wider than the whole bar (`safe` can't help there) — that still needs layout/width changes.
applies: Any flex row in Grafana core styled with justify-content flex-end near the docked left nav or similar fixed-position chrome
